about: Short stories read aloud to pre-readers, with picture-answer questions. g is grade-level difficulty (-1.0 = start of Pre-K).

stories.title: Sam's Red Ball
stories.text: Sam has a red ball. Sam likes his ball.

questions.why: Sam has a red ball.
The story says Sam has a red ball.

stories.title: Mia's Cat
stories.text: Mia has a cat. The cat likes milk.

questions.why: Mia has a cat.
The cat likes milk.

stories.title: Ben and the Duck
stories.text: Ben sees a duck. The duck is in the water. Quack, quack!

questions.why: Ben sees a duck.
The duck is in the water.

stories.title: Rosa's Snack
stories.text: Rosa is hungry. She eats an apple. Then she drinks some milk.

questions.why: Rosa eats an apple.
Rosa drinks some milk.

stories.title: The Rain
stories.text: Dark clouds came. Rain fell down. Kai got his umbrella.

questions.why: The story says rain fell down.
Kai got his umbrella.

stories.title: Max at the Park
stories.text: Max went to the park. He saw a dog. Max gave the dog a pat.

questions.why: Max went to the park.
Max saw a dog.

stories.title: The Bird's Nest
stories.text: A bird made a nest in a tree. She put three eggs in the nest. The eggs were small and blue.

questions.q: Where did the bird make her nest?
questions.why: The bird made her nest in a tree.

questions.q: How many eggs were in the nest?
questions.why: She put three eggs in the nest.

stories.title: Lily's Birthday
stories.text: Today is Lily's birthday. Her mom made a cake. Lily blew out the candles and made a wish.

questions.why: Lily's mom made a cake.
Lily blew out the candles.

stories.title: The Snowman
stories.text: Omar made a snowman. He gave it a carrot nose. He put a scarf on its neck. Then the sun came out.

questions.q: What did Omar use for the nose?
questions.why: Omar gave the snowman a carrot nose.

questions.q: What came out at the end?
questions.why: Then the sun came out.

stories.title: Nora's Lost Shoe
stories.text: Nora could not find her shoe. She looked under the bed. It was not there. Then she saw her puppy chewing something. It was her shoe!

questions.why: Nora looked under the bed first.
Her puppy was chewing her shoe.

stories.title: Ava's Seed
stories.text: Ava planted a seed in a pot. She gave it water every day. Soon a tiny green sprout came up.

questions.q: What did Ava give the seed every day?
questions.why: She gave it water every day.

questions.q: What came up from the seed?
questions.why: A tiny green sprout came up.

stories.title: Why Theo Wore a Coat
stories.text: It was a cold, snowy day. Theo put on his coat, a hat, and big mittens. He went outside to play. His nose got red, but he stayed warm.

questions.q: Why did Theo wear a coat?
questions.why: Theo wore a coat because it was a cold day.

questions.q: What did Theo wear on his hands?
questions.why: He put on big mittens.

stories.title: Bear's Long Nap
stories.text: Bear ate honey all fall. When it got cold, Bear went to sleep. He slept all winter. In spring, Bear woke up and was very hungry.

questions.q: What did Bear eat in the fall?
questions.why: Bear ate honey all fall.
In spring, Bear woke up.

stories.title: The Lost Puppy
stories.text: Ben found a little puppy in the rain. It had no collar. Ben took the puppy home and dried it with a towel. Then Ben drew a picture of the puppy for Mom to hang up.

questions.q: Where did Ben find the puppy?
questions.why: Ben found the puppy in the rain.

questions.q: What did Ben draw a picture of?
questions.why: Ben drew a picture of the puppy.

stories.title: Kai's Sandcastle
stories.text: Kai built a sandcastle at the beach. He packed wet sand into a bucket and flipped it over. Then a big wave came and washed it away. Kai laughed and began again.

questions.why: Kai built a sandcastle at the beach.
A big wave washed it away.

stories.title: The Runaway Balloon
stories.text: Rosa held a big red balloon at the party. On the way home, a gust of wind pulled the string from her hand. The balloon floated up, up, up. Rosa watched it go into the sky.

questions.q: Why did the balloon float away?
questions.why: A gust of wind pulled the string from her hand.
The balloon floated up into the sky.
